verdict.rationale: Alma is an immigration law firm whose service is attorney-led visa petitions delivered through a client portal. User-configurable autonomous background automations are not a meaningful axis for this kind of legal service. The homepage line about a system that 'keeps every case moving' describes the firm's internal case management, not automations a user sets up, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
